task.goal: Build `wordfreq`, a small Node.js command-line tool that prints the N most frequent words in a text file, with tests and a README. Use only the Node.js standard library.

sessions.brief: Build `wordfreq`, a small Node.js command-line tool that prints the N most frequent words in a text file, with tests and a README. Use only the Node.js standard library.

Implement the CLI and supporting package setup for wordfreq using only Node.js standard library. Own package.json, bin/wordfreq.js (or equivalent CLI), and core library module if useful. Agree expected CLI interface: `node bin/wordfreq.js <file> [N]`, default N=10; case-insensitive word tokens, punctuation excluded; print one `word count` per line sorted count descending then word alphabetical. Handle usage/file errors with nonzero exit and clear stderr. Report files/behavior.

Create tests for the wordfreq CLI/core contract. Own test/ files only. Assume interface `node bin/wordfreq.js <file> [N]`, default 10; normalize lowercase, tokens are Unicode letters/numbers/apostrophes? Coordinate with me: use a dependency-free node:test approach; test frequency ranking, ties, N limit/default, usage/errors. Please inspect actual implementation once available but don't edit its files. Report test results.

Please also provide the finalized parsing token policy: use Unicode letter/number sequences with internal apostrophe support if practical, and coordinate its exact expectation to Tester. CLI output / errors as described.
For consistency, target word tokenization as Unicode letter/number sequences (internal apostrophes may be treated as separators unless builder confirms otherwise). node:test, no dependencies.
Please add a concise README.md documenting install/use, default N, tokenization/order, errors, and tests. Own README.md only for this portion (in addition to your existing implementation files).
